# MyApp rsyslog configuration
# Filter messages from the myapp program and route to appropriate log files

# Route all myapp events to app_events.log
if $programname == 'myapp' then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/app_events.log" fileOwner="myapp" fileGroup="myapp" fileCreateMode="0644")
}

# Route only ERROR level events to app_errors.log
if $programname == 'myapp' and $msg contains '"level":"ERROR"' then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/app_errors.log" fileOwner="myapp" fileGroup="myapp" fileCreateMode="0644")
}

=== Logrotate Config ===
/var/log/app_events.log /var/log/app_errors.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 myapp myapp
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload rsyslog > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}

=== Monitoring Script ===
#!/bin/bash
#
# Service Health Monitoring Script
# Analyzes systemd journal to detect service issues and restart loops
#

SERVICE_NAME="myapp"
TIME_WINDOW="5 minutes"
RESTART_THRESHOLD=3

# Get current timestamp in ISO format
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

# Query journalctl for the last 5 minutes of myapp logs
# Using JSON output format for easier parsing
LOGS=$(journalctl -u ${SERVICE_NAME}.service --since "5 minutes ago" --output=json 2>/dev/null)

# Count restart events (when service starts)
# Look for "Started" in the MESSAGE field
RESTARTS=$(echo "${LOGS}" | grep -c '"MESSAGE".*"Started"' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "${RESTARTS}" ]; then
    RESTARTS=0
fi

# Count error events (messages containing ERROR)
ERRORS=$(echo "${LOGS}" | grep -c '"MESSAGE".*"ERROR"' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "${ERRORS}" ]; then
    ERRORS=0
fi

# Detect restart loops: more than 3 restarts in 5 minutes
if [ "${RESTARTS}" -gt "${RESTART_THRESHOLD}" ]; then
    RESTART_LOOP="true"
else
    RESTART_LOOP="false"
fi

# Output JSON report
cat << EOF
{
  "service": "${SERVICE_NAME}",
  "time_window": "${TIME_WINDOW}",
  "restarts": ${RESTARTS},
  "errors": ${ERRORS},
  "restart_loop_detected": ${RESTART_LOOP},
  "timestamp": "${TIMESTAMP}"
}
EOF
